proof_body:
by
  intro a b r a' b' r' hr hr'
  have hN : 0 ≤ (a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hSq := Real.sq_sqrt hN
  have hS0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2)
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases h0 : (a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2 = 0
    · obtain ⟨hA2, hB2⟩ := (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)).mp h0
      have hA : a - a' = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hA2
      have hB : b - b' = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hB2
      have e₁ : a' = a := by linarith
      have e₂ : b' = b := by linarith
      subst e₁ e₂
      have := h (a' + r) b' (by ring_nf; rfl)
      have h2 : r ^ 2 ≤ r' ^ 2 := by linarith
      have := (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h2 hr'.le).2
      rw [h0]; simpa using this
    · have hpos : 0 < (a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hN (Ne.symm h0)
      have hS : 0 < Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
      have hw := h (a + r * (a - a') / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2)) (b + r * (b - b') / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2)) (by
        apply le_of_eq
        field_simp
        rw [hSq]; ring)
      have e : (a + r * (a - a') / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) - a') ^ 2 + (b + r * (b - b') / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) - b') ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) + r) ^ 2 := by
        have ee : (a + r * (a - a') / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) - a') ^ 2 + (b + r * (b - b') / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) - b') ^ 2 = (1 + r / Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2)) ^ 2 * ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) := by
          field_simp; ring
        rw [ee, ← hSq]
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq hS.le]
        field_simp
      rw [e] at hw
      exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hw hr'.le).2
  · intro h x y hd
    have hdot : (x - a) * (a - a') + (y - b) * (b - b') ≤ r * Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) := by
      have hsq : ((x - a) * (a - a') + (y - b) * (b - b')) ^ 2 ≤ (r * Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, hSq]
        linarith [sq_nonneg ((x - a) * (b - b') - (y - b) * (a - a')), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hN]
      exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hsq (by positivity)).2
    have hb : (Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) + r) ^ 2 ≤ r' ^ 2 := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h 2
    have e : (x - a') ^ 2 + (y - b') ^ 2 = (x - a) ^ 2 + (y - b) ^ 2 + 2 * ((x - a) * (a - a') + (y - b) * (b - b')) + Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hSq]; ring
    have e₂ : (Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) + r) ^ 2 = Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (r * Real.sqrt ((a - a') ^ 2 + (b - b') ^ 2)) + r ^ 2 := by ring
    linarith
